row.answer: Alpha Strike makes Master Yi untargetable while he strikes nearby enemies, dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects. It can hit the same enemies again when other eligible targets are unavailable, with reduced effect on repeated hits. His basic attacks reduce its cooldown, and he can choose his exit direction relative to the primary target.
row.counterplay: Hold targeted control until he reappears, and avoid relying on his exit position being fixed.
